b1-27-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Keeping in Touch
b1-27-01.scenario: You are Meg. You are a student in Budapest. Carlos asks how you keep in touch with your sister Lauren.
b1-27-01.prompt: Tell Carlos how you keep in touch with Lauren and what you did yesterday.
cues: Say how you keep in touch with her
Say what you sent her yesterday
b1-27-01.target: Me mantengo en contacto con Lauren por mensaje. Ayer le mandé un mensaje.
b1-27-01.english: I keep in touch with Lauren by message. Yesterday I sent her a message.
b1-27-01.canDo: I can describe how people communicate and keep in touch.

b1-27-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What She Said
b1-27-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You work in an office in Budapest. Meg asks why you came home late, and you tell her about a colleague.
b1-27-02.prompt: Tell Meg what your colleague said and what she asked you.
b1-27-02.target: Una compañera me dijo que estaba ocupada y me preguntó si tenía tiempo.
b1-27-02.english: A colleague told me that she was busy and asked me if I had time.
b1-27-02.canDo: I can report basic statements and questions.

b1-27-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What Did She Mean?
b1-27-03.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos shows you a short message from his grandmother in Madrid and says he does not understand it. You think about what she wanted.
b1-27-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what his grandmother wanted to know and what she meant.
cues: Say what she wanted to know
b1-27-03.target: Tu abuela quería saber si íbamos a Madrid. Quiso decir que quiere vernos.
b1-27-03.english: Your grandmother wanted to know if we were going to Madrid. She meant that she wants to see us.
b1-27-03.canDo: I can explain indirect meaning and intention.

b1-27-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Can You Explain It?
b1-27-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg tells you something about her class and you do not understand. You ask her to explain it, then you understand.
b1-27-04.prompt: Ask Meg to explain and tell her that now you understand.
b1-27-04.target: ¿Puedes explicarlo otra vez? Ahora entiendo lo que querías decir.
b1-27-04.english: Can you explain it again? Now I understand what you meant.
b1-27-04.canDo: I can repair communication problems through clarification.

b1-27-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Don Dimas and the Devil
b1-27-05.scenario: You are Meg. You read a simplified retelling of «Don Dimas de la Tijereta», a tale by Ricardo Palma, for a class in Budapest. Carlos asks what happens.
b1-27-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what Dimas says on the hill and what happens in hell.
cues: Say what Dimas says on the hill
b1-27-05.target: Dimas dice que un diablo puede llevarse su almilla. Los jueces del infierno leen el contrato y deciden que Dimas gana.
b1-27-05.english: Dimas says that a devil can take his waistcoat. The judges in hell read the contract and decide that Dimas wins.
b1-27-05.canDo: I can describe an awkward interaction.

b1-27-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Clearing Up a Message
b1-27-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You work in an office in Budapest. Meg asks what happened with a message from your colleague.
b1-27-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what you thought and what your colleague explained.
b1-27-consolidation.target: Pensé que estaba triste, pero me explicó que estaba ocupada. Le pregunté qué quería decir y aclaramos el malentendido.
b1-27-consolidation.english: I thought she was sad, but she explained to me that she was busy. I asked her what she meant and we cleared up the misunderstanding.
b1-27-consolidation.canDo: I can use the words for communication and misunderstandings.
